jobs.title: Connect runtime, queue, and storage decisions
jobs.query: Which runtime, queue, and durable store form Cobalt's backend path?

corpus.text:
# Cobalt Runtime
The request service uses Rust and Axum.

# Cobalt Processing
Accepted jobs enter the cobalt-main queue.

# Cobalt Storage
Workers persist completed jobs in PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector.

# Rejected Design
A Redis-only durable store was rejected.

jobs.title: Trace deployment failure to recovery action
jobs.query: If Meridian's canary fails its latency gate, what sequence restores service?

corpus.text: Meridian deploys a 5 percent canary to the primary cluster.
The canary fails when p95 latency exceeds 240 milliseconds for ten minutes.
A failed Meridian canary is drained, then the last signed release is restored.
An unsigned manual image was used in a retired recovery draft.

jobs.title: Navigate a nested release policy
jobs.query: What approvals and evidence does Orion require before a public release?

corpus.text:
# Orion Release Policy
## Engineering gate
Integration tests must pass.
## Security gate
A security reviewer must approve the source-linked findings.
## Publication gate
The release owner must sign the final checksum manifest.
The Orion release owner is the Platform Runtime lead.
A draft proposed publishing before security review; it was rejected.

jobs.query: Who owns Juniper, which queue carries its work, and who receives a depth alert?

corpus.text: The Delivery Systems team owns Juniper.
Juniper production jobs use the cobalt-main queue.
When cobalt-main exceeds 500 Juniper jobs, alert the Delivery Systems on-call engineer.
The amber-old queue no longer carries Juniper work.

jobs.title: Retrieve a nested retention exception
jobs.query: How long does Lumen retain operational events, and which exception needs legal approval?

corpus.text:
# Lumen Data Handbook
## Operational events
Retain ordinary operational events for 30 days.
### Investigation hold
An active incident may extend retention to 60 days.
### Legal exception
Retention beyond 60 days requires written Legal approval and a case identifier.
## Backups
Encrypt every backup at rest.
The Compliance Engineering team administers Lumen retention.
A retired handbook retained all events for 90 days without approval.

Vega v2 clients must migrate to v3 before 2026-09-30.
Vega v2 was once the default interface but is retired.
